tasks.prompt: Read the protected API definition and api-test-interface.json without modifying either input. Implement api-test-generator.mjs using the public offline CLI contract. Run it for the given API definition to create generated/api-test-plan.json. Create api-test-report.json and report verification truthfully. Produce exactly the three declared outputs; do not install packages, contact a server, or use the network. Input path: api/openapi.json.

fixtures.api-test-interface.json:
{
  "schemaVersion": "skill-ir-api-tester-interface/v1",
  "interfaceId": "api-tester-generator-interface-v1",
  "protectedInputs": [
    "<task-openapi-path>",
    "api-test-interface.json"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "api-test-generator.mjs",
    "generated/api-test-plan.json",
    "api-test-report.json"
  ],
  "generator": {
    "path": "api-test-generator.mjs",
    "command": [
      "node",
      "api-test-generator.mjs",
      "--input",
      "<relative-openapi-path>",
      "--out",
      "<relative-plan-path>"
    ],
    "exitCode": 0,
    "deterministic": true
  },
  "plan": {
    "requiredFields": [
      "schemaVersion",
      "source",
      "framework",
      "endpoints"
    ],
    "endpointFields": [
      "method",
      "path",
      "cases"
    ],
    "caseFields": [
      "id",
      "category",
      "request",
      "expectedStatus",
      "assertions",
      "independent",
      "timeoutMs"
    ],
    "categoryValues": [
      "happy",
      "boundary",
      "error"
    ],
    "allowAdditionalFields": true,
    "allowAnyCaseOrder": true
  },
  "report": {
    "requiredFields": [
      "schemaVersion",
      "discoverySource",
      "generatedCaseCount",
      "verification",
      "limitations"
    ],
    "verificationStatus": [
      "passed",
      "failed",
      "not-run"
    ]
  },
  "resourcePolicy": {
    "network": false,
    "packageInstall": false,
    "allowedRuntime": "node",
    "availablePackages": [
      "yaml"
    ]
  },
  "outputPolicy": {
    "exactOutputSet": true,
    "freeTextLanguage": "any"
  }
}

eval.name: Protected inputs and deterministic generator execution
Cases reflect documented valid, boundary, and invalid inputs
Security and response assertions follow the public API definition
Cases are independent and verification claims are grounded

openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Webhook API
  version: 1.0.0
components:
  securitySchemes:
    signature:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Signature
paths:
  /webhooks:
    post:
      security:
        - signature: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [event, callbackUrl]
              properties:
                event: { type: string, enum: [created, deleted] }
                callbackUrl: { type: string, format: uri }
      responses:
        "202": { description: Accepted }
        "401": { description: Invalid signature }
        "422": { description: Invalid payload }
